name: Founder decision: Decide what a lead enters at, when everyone enters at the outside edge
text_content:
Finding 18.3. The record says new people always enter at the outside edge and the web never acquires altitude (WP p.9), with no exception written, and it seats the Operations Lead and the Maitre d at the center (WP p.9 to 10). Pre-opening both are hired from outside into the center. The leads' sheets, their entry terms, and the transparency sheet's advancement path all need a word the record does not have, and it cannot be a rank. Founders, with Session 8 for structure and Session 13 for the architecture.
